long_biography.plain_text:
In 2008, Karim Fehmi Karagulla endowed a scholarship at the American University of Beirut for engineering students with financial need. The award reflected the field in which he had built his public career. By the early 2000s, he was an engineer with a Beirut contracting business whose projects included major hotels and urban construction.

That early role placed him inside an established family enterprise. He later became chief executive of Gen Holding, the group's holding company. The operating contractor worked across roads, buildings, utilities, earthworks and other civil-engineering services. This progression took him from technical participation to executive responsibility. How any economic interest passed to him through inheritance, a lifetime transfer, investment or another mechanism remains undisclosed.
